thread:
tara: Hey team — planning a small smokeboard slab for atlas-6b quant bring-up. Goal: 700 samples to exercise hallucination, longcontext tokenization, and codegen regressions. Need carve + label ops. Thoughts?
aj: I can carve a candidate slab. Proposal: 500 NL (mix of long essays + short Q/A), 100 dialog turns, 100 code samples. Will include multi-lingual ambigs (es/fr) to catch tokenizer issues.
mike_r: Include 150 known regressed examples from prior q4b-onboard incidents for regression recall measurement. Also add a 50-sample "edge-retrieval" bucket for RAG triggers.
eva: I'll run dedupe: two-stage fuzzyhash (0.8) then paraphrase-cluster prune. Will attach provenance and token-count columns. ETA 8h for candidate CSV.
liz: Label ops can run a 48h microburst with 5 labelers. Need final rubric + UI config. Recommend fields: factuality, error_class, severity, reproduce. Also want a short checklist for code samples (compiles? reproduces?).
sanjay: Infra note: quant kernels applied for atlas-6b-int4. Also seeing a subtle tokenizer split on emoji + zero-width joiners that can change token counts — include ~30 emoji-heavy examples. We'll keep fp16 fallback if 95p latency >1.1s.
label-bot: label-bot: created job atlas_quant_smoke_1799999991, est throughput 480/hr.
tara: Good. Add a quick prompt-variant matrix: baseline prompt, "cite-sources" variant, and an "explain-reasoning" variant for 200 samples to surface hallucination modes.
aj: For code: include small function-level tasks plus REPL dialogues. Tag lang=py/js/sql. Will upload manifest to s3://redwood-internal/curation/atlas_smoke_1799999991/candidates.csv with language tags.
eva: Candidate list uploaded. Running 2nd dedupe pass now. Paraphrase threshold 0.6, removed 90 duplicates. Final count ~710.
liz: Drafting instructions:
```text
Fields:
- factuality: true|false|partial
- error_class: fabrication|contradiction|omission|tokenization|code-exec|other
- severity: 1-4
- reproduce_steps: text
- confidence: 0-100
- code_exec: yes|no|n/a
```
mike_r: After labels reach 60% run the eval harness: hallucination recall/precision, tokenization mismatch rate, code-exec pass rate. Produce a diff vs atlas-v1-fp16 and paste results here. Also surface top-15 failures with context.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: atlas-6b-int4 -> staging rollout complete (4/4 hosts). Observability streaming enabled.
sanjay: Perf quicks: int4 throughput +1.9x, but 95p latency on mixed prompts +10%. Sampling variance increased at low temp. Logging traces for triage.
label-bot: label-bot: first batch (250) assigned to labelers; ETA 5.5h.
tara: Thanks all — will follow up once eval diff is ready. :thumbsup:
